purpose: Determine whether one External Intelligence source family is ready for a separately preregistered first trial without consulting trial outcomes.

ineligible_until_separate_gate.CVM_IPE_METADATA: Requires a frozen schema-constrained classifier with semantic evaluation and evidence-span provenance before feature readiness can be assessed.

minimum_temporal_coverage.rule: For the selected family, eligible feature-bearing observations must span at least 730 calendar days between minimum and maximum reference dates.

minimum_independent_cohorts.cohort_definition: Distinct calendar months containing at least one eligible feature-bearing observation whose information set is fixed at that cohort cutoff.
minimum_independent_cohorts.dependence_rule: Multiple documents, revisions, securities, funds, days, or rows within one calendar month count as one cohort.

minimum_PIT_STRICT_coverage.denominator: All eligible feature-bearing observations, including PIT_RECONSTRUCTED and HISTORICAL_ONLY.

minimum_identity_coverage.numerator: Eligible feature-bearing observations with a temporally admissible official ticker, ISIN, issuer CNPJ, or official security code required by the candidate feature.
minimum_identity_coverage.denominator: All eligible feature-bearing observations after source-contract filtering; confidential aggregates and unresolved rows remain in the denominator when the feature requires security identity.

maximum_missingness.scope: Only fields explicitly required by the later preregistered feature definition.
maximum_missingness.rule: Structurally unavailable fields cannot be removed from the denominator merely to pass readiness.

selection_budget.selection_basis: Mechanism, source-contract quality, PIT coverage, identity coverage, and temporal coverage only; no target or return outcome.

baseline_identity.comparison_if_trial_occurs: Report standalone source-family value separately from incremental value versus this unchanged M12-1 baseline.

reserved_evaluation_definition.rule: Prospective monthly cohorts whose first complete source-version collection occurs strictly after the readiness-protocol commit and, if readiness passes, after a separate preregistration commit.

readiness_rules: Evaluate each eligible family independently using source/staging metadata only and without target or return outcomes.
A family passes only if every minimum temporal coverage, cohort count, PIT_STRICT coverage, identity coverage, and applicable missingness threshold passes.
The overall decision is READY only if at least one eligible family passes every criterion without expanding the selection or multiplicity budgets.
UNKNOWN, unsupported, confidential-unresolved, rejected, and HISTORICAL_ONLY observations cannot be silently removed from relevant denominators.
A READY decision permits only a separate preregistration freeze; it does not permit production promotion, capital use, or automatic trial execution.
A NOT_READY decision forbids exploratory outcome evaluation and records the exact quantitative shortfalls.

canonical_hash_representation.json: RFC 8259 object with lexicographically sorted keys, separators comma and colon, ensure_ascii=true, allow_nan=false
canonical_hash_representation.exclusion: Omit the top-level protocol_sha256 field before hashing.
